comment: Employers with engineering presence in the target cities, used to discover ATS
boards that no job board has named yet. Only 7 of 44 major Canadian tech firms
appeared anywhere in the US-centric GitHub feeds, so without this list their
boards are never queried at all.
Names are turned into candidate board slugs (lowercase, dashed, PascalCase) and
probed against Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and SmartRecruiters. A miss costs one
404; a hit permanently adds that employer to the enumeration.
Ordered roughly Montreal, Toronto, then US firms with Canadian offices.
The Montreal block at the end was recovered from a Summer-2026 archive of
Canadian internships: these employers demonstrably post Montreal SWE interns.
Only names whose board actually resolves are listed — of 43 such employers, 37
run Workday, Oracle or their own careers site, whose tenant IDs cannot be
guessed from a company name. Those are reachable only once some board names one
